name: workbuddy-dream-skin
description: Reversible theme/skin for the WorkBuddy desktop app via local loopback CDP injection. Never modifies app.asar, the official install directory, or code signing.

scripts.check: npm run check:syntax && npm run check:mirror && npm run check:payload
scripts.check:syntax: node --check macos/scripts/injector.mjs && node --check macos/scripts/cdp-client.mjs && node --check macos/scripts/theme-schema.mjs && bash -n macos/scripts/*.sh && python -m py_compile macos/scripts/gen_presets.py
scripts.check:mirror: diff macos/scripts/injector.mjs windows/scripts/injector.mjs && diff macos/scripts/cdp-client.mjs windows/scripts/cdp-client.mjs && diff macos/scripts/theme-schema.mjs windows/scripts/theme-schema.mjs && diff macos/assets/dream-skin.css windows/assets/dream-skin.css && diff macos/assets/renderer-inject.js windows/assets/renderer-inject.js
scripts.check:payload: node macos/scripts/injector.mjs --check-payload --theme-dir macos/presets/preset-aurora-dusk && node macos/scripts/injector.mjs --check-payload --theme-dir macos/presets/preset-midnight-bloom && node macos/scripts/injector.mjs --check-payload --theme-dir macos/presets/preset-ember-zen
